violated_contract: A client must settle an admitted manual merge from authoritative server state even if its best-effort completion push is lost. The new target has a distinct identity; a completed source is not that target, and a read failure is not proof of source deletion. A confirmed replacement must also remove sources from cached and in-flight list projections.
canonical_prevention: Return the stable admitted target, journal source/target IDs within account and backend scope, and use one bounded typed observer plus one list/cache commit for push and polling. Serialize cache reconciliation and await journal retirement so concurrent completions preserve every replacement across offline reopen. Require authoritative source absence and target readiness; fence stale reads and never resubmit destructive work to recover observation.
